app.description: Pick vLLM/SGLang tool-call and reasoning parser flags from a model's chat template, and replay captured raw output offline to see why a tool call leaked. No GPU or running server needed.
help.epilog: SOURCE is a model folder, hf:<org>/<repo>[@rev] (plain HTTPS download; set HF_TOKEN for gated repos, HF_ENDPOINT for a mirror), or fixture:<name> (built-in practice mock). Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 problem found, 2 usage or input error, 4 download failed.
help.help: show this help message and exit
help.version: show the version number and exit
help.lang: UI language: en or ko (default: PARSERPICK_LANG, then LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG, then English)
help.json: print machine-readable JSON (keys and codes are language independent)
help.cmd.inspect: recommend serving flags for a model's chat template
help.cmd.replay: replay a captured raw output: reasoning split, then tool extraction
help.cmd.check: render-test a chat template with the message shapes tool-calling clients send
help.cmd.demo: run everything on built-in practice mock fixtures (offline)
help.engine: serving engine to print flags for (default: vllm)
help.engine_version: engine version you run; a version other than the verified one adds a warning
help.capture: captured output: a text file, a /v1/completions JSON response, or fixture:<name>

help.reasoning: reasoning parser or rule: think, think_implicit_start, none, qwen3, deepseek_r1, ...
help.model: derive format and reasoning rule from this model's template (same SOURCE forms)

mock.fixture_banner: Practice mock fixture: a synthetic, abbreviated template written for parserpick, not a real model's. Use a folder or hf:<repo> for real models.
replay.approx: Replay approximates engine behavior; it is not byte-identical to any engine's parser.
issue.template-syntax-error: The chat template '{name}' has a Jinja syntax error: {detail}. The server will fail on every request that uses it. Run check-template for details and fix the template first.
issue.unknown-format: No known tool-call markers found in the template or special tokens, so no parser can be recommended. The model may not support tool calling, or its format is not in the table yet.
issue.ambiguous: Markers of several unrelated formats are present ({markers}); the first matching family was picked. Check the evidence before serving.
issue.tools-not-rendered: The chat template never reads the 'tools' variable, so tool definitions will not reach the model. Pass a tool-aware template: --chat-template {hint}
issue.tools-not-rendered.nohint: The chat template never reads the 'tools' variable, so tool definitions will not reach the model. Supply a template that renders tools with --chat-template.
issue.named-template: The checkpoint ships several named templates. vLLM picks the '{name}' one by itself for requests that send tools, so no flag is needed (--chat-template {name} would stop vLLM from starting: it reads the value as a file path).
issue.named-template.sglang: The checkpoint ships several named templates and SGLang uses the first one unless told otherwise; tool calling needs the '{name}' one. Added --hf-chat-template-name {name} (--chat-template only takes a built-in template name or a file path).
issue.response-template-present: The checkpoint declares a response_template, so vLLM's generic 'hf' parser can read its output format. Recommended --tool-call-parser hf / --reasoning-parser hf.
issue.response-template-present.sglang: The checkpoint declares a response_template, but SGLang's docs list no generic parser for it; the fingerprint-based flags below are used.
issue.unverified-engine-version: {engine} {version} differs from the version the table was verified against ({verified}). Parser names can change between releases; check {url}
issue.no-engine-parser: No documented {engine} tool-call parser name for the '{family}' family ({label}), so no tool-call flags are printed. Without a parser, calls made under tool_choice "auto" come back as plain text in content; use another engine or a custom parser.
issue.no-engine-parser.vllm: No documented vLLM tool-call parser name for the '{family}' family ({label}), so no tool-call flags are printed. --enable-auto-tool-choice is left out too: vLLM refuses to start with it but without --tool-call-parser. Without a parser, vLLM rejects requests that send tools with tool_choice "auto" or "required"; use another engine or a custom parser plugin (--tool-parser-plugin).
issue.no-engine-reasoning: No documented {engine} reasoning parser name for the '{family}' family; flag omitted.
issue.old-name: Older docs and issues call this parser '{old}' (now '{new}'). Source: {url}
note.reasoning_name_unlisted: The reasoning parser name '{name}' comes from engine recipes and is not on the reasoning-parser docs page checked on 2026-11-19; confirm it for your version.
issue.call-inside-reasoning: A tool call ({detected} markers) sits inside the reasoning block. Engines split reasoning first and only parse tool calls from the remaining content, so this call is lost (vLLM issue 39056 pattern). Try disabling thinking, prompting for calls after the thinking block, or checking your engine version.
issue.parser-mismatch: Tool-call text was left in content: it looks like '{detected}' but the '{chosen}' parser was used. Use --tool-call-parser {suggest} (vLLM: {vllm}, SGLang: {sglang}).
issue.parser-mismatch.noname: Tool-call text was left in content: it looks like '{detected}' but the '{chosen}' parser was used. {engine} documents no tool-call parser for '{detected}', so no flag fixes this on this engine; use another engine or a custom parser plugin (vLLM: {vllm}, SGLang: {sglang}).
issue.broken-arguments: A call was found but could not be parsed: {detail}
issue.unclosed-call: The output stops inside a tool call ({detail}). Suspect a stop string, max_tokens or finish_reason=length cut-off.
issue.no-call: No tool call and no tool-call markers in this output; the model answered in plain text.
issue.text-mixed-pythonic: Text surrounds the pythonic call list; pythonic parsers expect the list alone.
check.tools_rendered.pass: Tool definitions appear in the rendered prompt.
check.tools_rendered.fail: Tool definitions do not appear in the rendered prompt; the model never sees the tools.
check.dict_arguments.pass: Past tool calls with dict arguments render.
check.string_arguments.pass: Past tool calls with JSON-string arguments render without double encoding.
check.string_arguments.double_encoded: JSON-string arguments are encoded a second time (escaped quotes) in the prompt.
check.string_arguments.error: JSON-string arguments break rendering: {error_type}: {detail}. Fine if your engine converts arguments to dicts first.
check.arguments_dropped: Rendered, but the argument values do not appear in the prompt.
check.tool_call_id.pass: OpenAI-style call IDs (call_ + 24 characters) are accepted.
check.tool_role.pass: A tool-role message after a call renders.
check.tool_role.fail: The tool-role message content does not appear in the prompt.
check.time_limit: Stopped: rendering did not finish within the {seconds}-second limit for all checks, so the render process was killed. The template may loop forever.
check.time_budget: Stopped: rendering used up the {seconds}-second time budget shared by all checks. The template may loop forever or be very slow.
check.not_run: Not run: the {seconds}-second limit for all checks was used up by an earlier check.
detail.repeat-limit: repeating a sequence more than {limit} items is not allowed
detail.not-run: not run: time limit used up
detail.no-name: the call object has no string 'name'
detail.list-unclosed: the call list is never closed
detail.not-a-list: the call text is not a list
detail.unparsed-body: the text between the call markers does not match this format
argparse.invalid_choice_suggest: invalid choice: %(value)r, maybe you meant %(closest)r? (choose from %(choices)s)
argparse.one_required: one of the arguments %s is required
err.no_template: {label}: no chat template found (looked for chat_template.jinja, tokenizer_config.json chat_template, chat_template.json).
err.not_dir: {path}: not a directory. Pass a model folder, hf:<org>/<repo> or fixture:<name>.
err.http: GET {url} failed with HTTP {status}. Check the repo id and revision; for gated repos set HF_TOKEN, or pass a local folder.
err.network: GET {url} failed: {reason}. Check the network or proxy, set HF_ENDPOINT to a mirror, or pass a local folder.
err.bad_repo: '{spec}' is not a valid Hugging Face repo id; use hf:<org>/<repo>[@revision].
err.capture_shape: The JSON capture has 'choices' but no choices[0].text; pass a /v1/completions response or a plain text file.
err.template_encoding: {path}: not valid UTF-8 text. Save the file as UTF-8 or point to the right model folder.
err.need_format: replay needs --format (or --model) to know which parser to emulate.
err.no_replay_rule: '{name}' has no replay rule yet. Replayable: {available}
err.unknown_reasoning: Unknown reasoning parser '{name}'. Use one of: {available}
err.model_unusable: Cannot derive a replay format from {source}: no tool-call format recognized.
